coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same high‑severity failures for the Broad Coverage criterion: each exhibits Missing Major Aspect, Lack of Context, Narrow Focus, and Superficial Listing. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses contain fatal internal‑consistency problems (blurred viewpoints/conflation and unresolved conflict).
